raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Adds B300 (SM103) plans for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next TP=1 BF16 linears (DGX Station GB300 recipe); SM103 had TP=4 shapes only. Also adds the SM103 case to the per-arch plan correctness test.

## Claims

- 1.26–3.06x over cuBLAS per cell on cold L2, faster on hot L2 too; ≈ 0.52 ms saved per decode step at bs1.

## Validation

```
pytest tests/kernels/test_bf16_skinny_gemm.py -k qwen4_exp          → 41 passed, 130 skipped (B300)
qwen4_exp_low_latency_gemm vs F.linear (CUPTI, CUDA graph, 14 cells) → all faster, cold and hot L2
```

| projection | (N, K) | M | cuBLAS → plan (µs, cold L2) | speedup cold / hot |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GDN B/A | (96, 2560) | 1, 2, 4 | 5.98 → 2.18 (M=1) | 2.74–3.06x / 3.55–4.04x |
| HC final down | (320, 10240) | 1, 2, 4 | 7.62 → 3.87 (M=1) | 1.49–1.97x / 1.68–2.89x |
| shared gate/up | (1280, 2560) | 1, 2, 4 | 6.21 → 3.84 (M=1) | 1.38–1.62x / 1.73–2.27x |
| QSA QKV | (13952, 2560) | 1 | 20.13 → 14.56 | 1.38x / 1.42x |
| shared down | (2560, 640) | 1, 2 | 4.19 → 3.07 (M=1) | 1.34–1.36x / 1.39–1.62x |
| GDN/QSA out | (2560, 6144) | 1, 2 | 11.04 → 8.42 (M=1) | 1.26–1.31x / 1.37–2.06x |

## Details

Losing cells stay on cuBLAS (GDN QKVZ, LM head). Router left to #57848. CI has no SM103 runner, so the new test skips there. No e2e.
